en: The Rattanakosin Kingdom as the Siamese kingdom between 1782 and 1932, called the Kingdom of Siam after 1855
Its foundation in 1782 with Bangkok replacing Thonburi as the capital
Government on the mandala system, with high local autonomy under a distant centre
Its rule over its area through influence rather than direct administration
zh: 拉达那哥欣王国是1782至1932年的暹罗王国，1855年后称暹罗国
1782年建都曼谷，取代吞武里成为首都
按曼陀罗体系治理，地方高度自治
通过影响力而非直接行政统治其范围

politics.zh: 拉达那哥欣王国指1782至1932年间的暹罗王国，即今泰国，1855年后又称暹罗国。1782年拉达那哥欣（曼谷）建立，取代吞武里成为暹罗首都。王国按曼陀罗体系治理，地方享有高度自治，中央通过影响力而非直接行政来统治其范围，直到1932年立宪革命结束君主专制。
politics.en: The Rattanakosin Kingdom refers to the Siamese kingdom in what is now Thailand between 1782 and 1932, called the Kingdom of Siam after 1855. It was founded in 1782 when Rattanakosin, today Bangkok, replaced Thonburi as the capital of Siam. The kingdom governed on the mandala system, which allowed high local autonomy while the centre influenced and effectively ruled its area through relations of allegiance rather than direct administration.

economy.zh: 曼谷位于昭披耶河下游，靠近暹罗湾，是稻米、柚木与对外贸易的中心，19世纪与中国的朝贡贸易和与西方的条约贸易共同塑造其经济。
economy.en: Bangkok, on the lower Chao Phraya near the Gulf of Siam, became the centre of rice, teak and foreign trade, and nineteenth-century tributary trade with China together with treaty trade with Western powers shaped its economy.

culture.zh: 王国延续阿瑜陀耶以来的佛教王权传统与宫廷礼仪，同时19世纪逐步引入西方技术与行政制度。曼谷成为国家宗教、艺术与教育的中心。
culture.en: The kingdom continued the Buddhist kingship and court ceremony inherited from Ayutthaya while adopting Western technical and administrative practices in the nineteenth century. Bangkok became the centre of national religion, art and education. Temples and palaces of the early Bangkok period date from this time.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1782年建都与王朝建立、19世纪与西方列强签订条约并改革行政、1855年后改称暹罗国，以及1932年立宪革命结束绝对君主制。
events.en: Key moments are the founding of the capital and dynasty in 1782, the treaties with Western powers and administrative reforms of the nineteenth century, the adoption of the name Siam after 1855 and the constitutional revolution of 1932 that ended absolute monarchy.

value.zh: 1782年建都曼谷，取代吞武里。
value.en: Bangkok replaced Thonburi as the capital in 1782.

value.zh: 按曼陀罗体系治理，地方高度自治。
value.en: It governed on the mandala system with high local autonomy.

entries.scopeNoteZh: 该条目的中文维基条目内容在本轮首轮抓取中未取到（检索命中其他条目），叙述依据英文维基百科条目；中文引用仅在 pageprops 核验确认条目实体一致后保留。
entries.scopeNoteEn: The Chinese Wikipedia introduction was not captured in the first pass (the search returned an unrelated page), so the essay rests on the English article; the Chinese citation is kept only because the pageprops check confirmed the same entity.

en: The Johor Sultanate as the sultanate founded in 1528 by Alauddin Riayat Shah II, son of the last Malacca sultan
Johor's place within the Malacca Sultanate before the Portuguese took its capital in 1511
Its control at its height over Johor, Riau, Pahang, Terengganu and parts of Sumatra
Its territory extending from the Klang river to Singapore and islands of the region
zh: 柔佛苏丹国由马六甲苏丹马末沙之子阿拉乌丁二世于1528年建立
1511年葡萄牙占领马六甲之前，柔佛属马六甲苏丹国领土
全盛时控制柔佛、廖内、彭亨、登嘉楼与苏门答腊部分地区
领土自巴生河一带延伸至新加坡及周边岛屿

politics.zh: 柔佛苏丹国又称柔佛-彭亨、柔佛-廖内或柔佛王朝，由马六甲苏丹马末沙之子阿拉乌丁·里阿耶特沙二世于1528年建立。1511年葡萄牙攻占马六甲之前，柔佛是马六甲苏丹国的一部分，马六甲陷落后柔佛苏丹国因而成立。全盛时它控制柔佛、廖内、彭亨、登嘉楼与苏门答腊部分地区，领土自巴生河一带延伸至宁宜、麻坡、峇株巴辖、新加坡与丁宜岛等地。
politics.en: The Johor Sultanate, also called Johor-Pahang-Riau-Lingga or the Johor Empire, was founded in 1528 by Alauddin Riayat Shah II, son of the last sultan of Malacca. Before the Portuguese captured Malacca's capital in 1511 Johor had been part of the Malacca Sultanate, and the new sultanate emerged after its fall. At its height it controlled Johor, Riau, Pahang, Terengganu and parts of Sumatra, with territory running from the Klang river to Singapore and the islands of the region.

economy.zh: 柔佛控制马六甲海峡东段的港口与河网，参与香料、锡与布匹贸易，廖内群岛的港口是区域转运中心。贸易收入是苏丹国财政的主要来源。
economy.en: Johor controlled ports and river routes on the eastern side of the Strait of Malacca and took part in the trade in spices, tin and cloth, with the ports of the Riau islands serving as regional transshipment centres. Trade revenue was the main source of the sultanate's income.

culture.zh: 柔佛继承马六甲宫廷的马来伊斯兰文化传统，马来语与爪夷文用于行政与文学，伊斯兰法与国家礼仪相互结合。，并保留了马六甲的宫廷礼仪与传统。
culture.en: Johor inherited the Malay Islamic court culture of Malacca, with Malay and Jawi used in administration and literature and Islamic law combined with court ceremony. Court literature and chronicles were written in Malay and Jawi.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1511年马六甲陷落、1528年柔佛苏丹国建立、17世纪与葡萄牙及亚齐的争夺、18世纪廖内-林加的分立，以及19世纪英国势力的介入。
events.en: Key moments are the fall of Malacca in 1511, the founding of the Johor Sultanate in 1528, the seventeenth-century contests with Portugal and Aceh, the separation of Riau-Lingga in the eighteenth century and the arrival of British power in the nineteenth.

value.zh: 1528年由马六甲苏丹之子阿拉乌丁二世建立。
value.en: Founded in 1528 by Alauddin Riayat Shah II, son of the Malacca sultan.

value.zh: 全盛时领有柔佛、廖内、彭亨与苏门答腊部分地区。
value.en: At its height it held Johor, Riau, Pahang and parts of Sumatra.

en: The Sultanate of Sulu as a Sunni Muslim Tausug state in the Sulu Archipelago
Its rule over coastal Zamboanga and parts of Palawan in the present Philippines
Its reach into parts of present-day Sabah, North Kalimantan and north-eastern Borneo
Trade relations with China, Malaya and Indonesia, with its capital at Jolo
zh: 苏禄苏丹国是苏禄群岛的逊尼派陶苏格人国家
统治今菲律宾三宝颜沿海与巴拉望部分地区和乐
势力及于今沙巴、北加里曼丹与婆罗洲东北部部分地区
与中国、马来亚及印尼有贸易往来，首都位于和乐

politics.zh: 苏禄苏丹国全称苏禄和平之家伊斯兰苏丹国，是陶苏格人建立的逊尼派伊斯兰国家，约于1457年立国，统治苏禄群岛以及今菲律宾三宝颜市沿海、巴拉望部分地区，并及于今沙巴、北加里曼丹与婆罗洲东北部一带，首都位于和乐。它与中国明朝、清朝以及马来亚、印尼长期保持贸易关系。
politics.en: The Sultanate of Sulu, in full the Sultanate of Sulu Dar al-Islam, was a Sunni Muslim state of the Tausug people founded in the mid-fifteenth century. It ruled the Sulu Archipelago together with coastal areas of Zamboanga City and parts of Palawan in the present Philippines, and reached into parts of what are now Sabah, North Kalimantan and north-eastern Borneo, with its capital at Jolo. It maintained trading relations with Ming and Qing China as well as with Malaya and Indonesia.

economy.zh: 苏禄群岛地处环苏禄海贸易要道，珍珠、海产、林产品与布匹是主要交换物，和乐港是区域集散中心。与中国及东南亚各地的贸易构成国家财源。
economy.en: The Sulu Archipelago lay on the trade routes around the Sulu Sea, where pearls, marine and forest products and cloth were exchanged, and the port of Jolo was a regional entrepot. Trade with China and with Southeast Asian polities formed the state's revenue.

culture.zh: 苏禄社会以陶苏格人为主体，伊斯兰教与本地习俗结合，陶苏格语、阿拉伯语与马来语在宗教与行政中使用。苏丹宫廷是环苏禄海地区伊斯兰文化的中心之一。
culture.en: Sulu society was centred on the Tausug people, with Islam combined with local custom and Tausug, Arabic and Malay used in religion and administration. The sultan's court was one of the centres of Islamic culture around the Sulu Sea.

events.zh: 关键节点包括15世纪中期立国、与明朝建立朝贡与贸易关系、19世纪与西班牙及英国势力的对抗，以及20世纪初苏丹国主权的终结。
events.en: Key moments are the founding in the mid-fifteenth century, the establishment of tributary and trading relations with Ming China, the nineteenth-century confrontations with Spanish and British power and the end of the sultanate's sovereignty in the early twentieth century.

value.zh: 首都位于和乐。
value.en: Its capital was at Jolo.

value.zh: 与中国明清两代及马来亚、印尼有贸易关系。
value.en: It traded with Ming and Qing China as well as with Malaya and Indonesia.

en: The Sultanate of Palembang Darussalam as an early modern polity in southern Sumatra
Its proclamation in 1659 by Susuhunan Abdurrahman
Its dissolution by the Dutch East Indies government on 7 October 1823
Its last ruler and the end of the sultanate in the 1820s
zh: 巨港苏丹国是苏门答腊南部的早期现代政体
1659年由苏苏胡南·阿卜杜拉赫曼宣告建立
1823年10月7日被荷属东印度政府解散
末代统治者的命运在1820年代终结了苏丹国

politics.zh: 巨港苏丹国全称巨港和平之家苏丹国，是印度尼西亚苏门答腊岛南部的早期现代政体，由苏丹统治。1659年苏苏胡南·阿卜杜拉赫曼宣告建立，1823年10月7日被荷属东印度殖民政府解散，末代统治者在此后被迫流亡，苏丹国就此终结。
politics.en: The Sultanate of Palembang Darussalam was an early modern polity in the southern part of the Indonesian island of Sumatra, ruled by the sultans of Palembang. It was proclaimed in 1659 by Susuhunan Abdurrahman and dissolved by the colonial government of the Dutch East Indies on 7 October 1823, after which its last ruler was forced into exile and the sultanate came to an end.

economy.zh: 巨港位于穆西河下游，靠近邦加海峡，是苏门答腊南部通往爪哇与马六甲海峡的贸易枢纽，胡椒、锡与林产品是主要商品。
economy.en: Palembang lies on the lower Musi river near the Bangka Strait and served as the trade hub of southern Sumatra towards Java and the Strait of Malacca, with pepper, tin and forest products as its main goods.

culture.zh: 苏丹国是马来伊斯兰文化在苏门答腊南部的重要中心，马来语与爪夷文用于行政与宗教文本，宫廷与港口城市形成独特的城市文化。
culture.en: The sultanate was an important centre of Malay Islamic culture in southern Sumatra, with Malay and Jawi used in administration and religious texts and a distinctive urban culture in the court and port city. Malay manuscripts from the region record its court and trade.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1659年建国、17至18世纪的贸易繁荣、与荷兰东印度公司的冲突，以及1823年苏丹国被解散、末代苏丹流亡。
events.en: Key moments are the proclamation of 1659, the commercial prosperity of the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, the conflicts with the Dutch East India Company and the dissolution of the sultanate in 1823 with the exile of its last sultan.

value.zh: 1659年由苏苏胡南·阿卜杜拉赫曼宣告建立。
value.en: It was proclaimed in 1659 by Susuhunan Abdurrahman.

value.zh: 1823年10月7日被荷属东印度政府解散。
value.en: It was dissolved by the Dutch East Indies government on 7 October 1823.

entries.scopeNoteZh: 中文维基百科没有该苏丹国的条目（检索命中的是马六甲苏丹国与机场等无关页面），条目依据英文维基百科条目与维基数据实体。
entries.scopeNoteEn: Chinese Wikipedia has no article on this sultanate, the search having returned unrelated pages such as the Malacca Sultanate and an airport; the essay rests on the English article and the Wikidata entity.

en: The Nguyễn lords as a noble clan ruling southern Đại Việt during the Revival Lê dynasty, 1558-1777 and 1780-1802
Their territory known as Đàng Trong, the Inner Realm, and to foreigners as the Kingdom of Cochinchina
Their nominal allegiance to the Lê emperors while ruling as an independent power
Their role as the forerunner of the Nguyễn dynasty of 1802-1945
zh: 阮主是后黎朝时期统治大越南部的贵族家族，1558至1777年、1780至1802年在位
其领地称塘中（内路），外人称广南国
名义上奉后黎朝皇帝为君主，实际独立
是1802至1945年阮朝的前身

politics.zh: 广南国又称阮主或阮氏，是越南南北朝与郑阮纷争时期统治大越南部的贵族政权，由阮氏家族世袭掌权。阮主名义上奉后黎朝皇帝为君主并使用其年号，实际上是独立国家；其领地当时称塘中（内路），外人称广南国。阮福阔在位时开始使用王的称谓，阮主也是1802至1945年阮朝的前身。
politics.en: The Nguyen lords, also called the Nguyen clan, were a hereditary noble house that ruled southern Dai Viet during the Revival Le dynasty, from 1558 to 1777 and again from 1780 to 1802. They acknowledged the Le emperors as sovereigns and used their reign titles while ruling in practice as an independent power; their territory was known as Dang Trong, the Inner Realm, and to foreigners as the Kingdom of Cochinchina. Under Nguyen Phuc Khoat they began to use the title of king, and the house was the forerunner of the Nguyen dynasty of 1802-1945.

economy.zh: 广南国面向南海，会安等港口是17至18世纪东亚与东南亚贸易的重要节点，日本、中国与欧洲商人在此交易丝绸、陶瓷、糖与香料。
economy.en: Facing the South China Sea, the Nguyen realm had ports such as Hoi An that were important nodes of East and Southeast Asian trade in the seventeenth and eighteenth centuries, where Japanese, Chinese and European merchants traded silk, ceramics, sugar and spices.

culture.zh: 阮主治下的南部继续向南扩张，吸收占婆与高棉地区的人口与文化，形成与北方不同的地方传统。汉字与喃字用于行政与文学。
culture.en: Under the Nguyen lords the south continued to expand, absorbing Cham and Khmer populations and cultures and developing local traditions distinct from the north. Chinese characters and the demotic nom script were used in administration and literature.

events.zh: 关键节点包括1558年阮氏受命镇守顺化、17世纪郑阮对峙、18世纪向南扩张至湄公河三角洲，以及1777年后一度中断、1802年阮福映建立阮朝。
events.en: Key moments are the appointment of the Nguyen to guard Hue in 1558, the seventeenth-century stand-off with the Trinh, the southward expansion into the Mekong delta in the eighteenth century, the interruption after 1777 and the founding of the Nguyen dynasty by Nguyen Phuc Anh in 1802.

value.zh: 领地称塘中（内路），外人称广南国。
value.en: Its territory was called Dang Trong and Cochinchina by foreigners.

value.zh: 是1802至1945年阮朝的前身。
value.en: It was the forerunner of the Nguyen dynasty of 1802-1945.

en: The Banten Sultanate as a trading kingdom founded in the sixteenth century on the north-west coast of Java
Its centre at Banten, a port city whose English name was Bantam
Its foundation attributed to Sunan Gunungjati, who had previously founded Cirebon
Its rise as a great pepper trading centre and its end under the Dutch East India Company
zh: 万丹苏丹国是16世纪在爪哇西北岸建立的贸易王国
中心在万丹港，英文旧称Bantam
相传由此前建立井里汶的苏南·古农·贾蒂建立
曾为东南亚重要的胡椒贸易中心，后被荷兰东印度公司并吞

politics.zh: 万丹苏丹国是16世纪在爪哇西北岸建立的伊斯兰贸易王国，中心在港口城市万丹，英文旧称Bantam。相传由此前建立井里汶的苏南·古农·贾蒂创建。它一度是东南亚重要的贸易中心，尤其以胡椒贸易著称；17世纪中期起受荷兰东印度公司压制，内乱频仍，1813年被荷属东印度方面吞并。
politics.en: The Banten Sultanate was an Islamic trading kingdom founded in the sixteenth century on the north-west coast of Java and centred on the port city of Banten, whose English name was Bantam. It is said to have been founded by Sunan Gunungjati, who had previously founded Cirebon. Once a great trading centre in Southeast Asia, especially for pepper, it came under the pressure of the Dutch East India Company in the mid-seventeenth century and was absorbed in 1813.

economy.zh: 万丹港控制爪哇西端的胡椒产区与通往马六甲海峡与印度洋的航线，胡椒、香料与布匹贸易使苏丹国在16至17世纪繁荣。
economy.en: The port of Banten controlled the pepper-growing districts of western Java and the routes towards the Strait of Malacca and the Indian Ocean, and the trade in pepper, spices and cloth made the sultanate prosperous in the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries.

culture.zh: 万丹是爪哇伊斯兰化的重要中心，苏丹兼宗教领袖，政教合一。巽他语与爪哇语传统同伊斯兰制度结合，清真寺与宫廷建筑留下明显痕迹。
culture.en: Banten was an important centre of Islamisation in Java, where the sultan was also a religious leader. Sundanese and Javanese traditions combined with Islamic institutions, and mosques and court buildings leave visible traces. The great mosque of Banten survives from the sultanate.

events.zh: 关键节点包括16世纪建国、16至17世纪的胡椒贸易繁荣、17世纪中期荷兰东印度公司的压制与内乱，以及1813年被并吞。
events.en: Key moments are the founding in the sixteenth century, the pepper-trade prosperity of the sixteenth and seventeenth centuries, the pressure and internal strife under the Dutch East India Company from the mid-seventeenth century and the absorption of 1813.

value.zh: 中心在万丹港，英文旧称Bantam。
value.en: Its centre was the port of Banten, known in English as Bantam.

value.zh: 以胡椒贸易著称，是东南亚重要贸易中心。
value.en: It was known for the pepper trade and was a major Southeast Asian trading centre.

en: Namayan as an independent polity on the banks of the Pasig River in the Philippines, also called Sapa
Its probable peak between the eleventh and fourteenth centuries
Its continued settlement until European colonisers arrived in the 1570s
Its formation as a polity of several barangays among others along the Pasig
zh: 纳马扬是菲律宾帕西格河畔的独立政体，又称萨帕
一般认为其鼎盛期在11至14世纪
一直有人居住，直到1570年代欧洲殖民者到来
由若干巴朗盖组成的政体，是帕西格河沿岸诸政体之一

politics.zh: 纳马扬又称萨帕，有时称拉马扬，是菲律宾帕西格河畔的独立政体。它由若干巴朗盖组成，是帕西格河沿岸多个政体之一，一般认为在11至14世纪达到鼎盛，此后仍有人居住，直到1570年代欧洲殖民者到来。其名称见於当地文字记载与后世文献。
politics.en: Namayan, also called Sapa and sometimes Lamayan, was an independent polity on the banks of the Pasig River in the Philippines. Formed as a polity occupying several barangays, it was one of several such polities along the Pasig, believed to have peaked between the eleventh and fourteenth centuries, and it continued to be inhabited until European colonisers arrived in the 1570s.

economy.zh: 政体位于帕西格河下游，河运与渔业是生计基础，与马尼拉湾沿岸及内陆的交换联系着当地社区。文献对其经济细节记载很少。
economy.en: The polity lay on the lower Pasig, where river transport and fishing supported its communities, and exchange with the shores of Manila Bay and the interior linked them. The sources say little about its economy in detail.

culture.zh: 当地社会以巴朗盖为单位，使用本地文字，信仰与习俗见于西班牙人到来后的记载。纳马扬与汤都、马尼拉等帕西格河沿岸政体共享相近的文化传统。
culture.en: Local society was organised in barangays and used a native script, and its beliefs and customs are recorded in accounts written after the Spanish arrival. Namayan shared cultural traditions with neighbouring Pasig polities such as Tondo and Maynila.

events.zh: 关键节点包括政体在11至14世纪的鼎盛、此后作为帕西格河沿岸政体之一延续，以及1570年代西班牙人到来的终结。
events.en: Key moments are the polity's peak between the eleventh and fourteenth centuries, its continuation as one of the Pasig polities, and its end with the arrival of the Spanish in the 1570s. Spanish accounts describe the polity in the following decades.

value.zh: 位于菲律宾帕西格河畔，又称萨帕。
value.en: It lay on the banks of the Pasig River in the Philippines and was also called Sapa.

value.zh: 一般认为鼎盛期在11至14世纪。
value.en: It is believed to have peaked between the eleventh and fourteenth centuries.

entries.scopeNoteZh: 中文维基百科没有该政体的独立条目，叙述依据英文维基百科条目与维基数据实体。
entries.scopeNoteEn: Chinese Wikipedia has no separate article on this polity, so the essay rests on the English article and the Wikidata entity.

en: Tarumanagara as an early Sundanese Indianised kingdom in western Java
Its fifth-century ruler Purnawarman and the earliest known inscriptions in Java, dated around 358 AD
At least seven stone inscriptions connected with the kingdom found near Bogor and Jakarta
The inscriptions named Ciaruteun, Kebon Kopi, Jambu, Pasir Awi and Muara among others
zh: 塔鲁曼内格拉是西爪哇早期的巽他印度化王国
5世纪统治者普尔纳瓦曼留下爪哇已知最早铭文，约刻于公元358年
在茂物与雅加达一带发现至少七块与该国相关的石碑
包括芝阿鲁特恩、克邦科皮、詹布、帕西尔阿维与穆阿拉等铭文

politics.zh: 塔鲁曼内格拉又称塔鲁马王国，是西爪哇早期的巽他印度化王国。其5世纪统治者普尔纳瓦曼留下了爪哇已知最早的铭文，年代约在公元358年前后；在茂物与雅加达一带至少发现七块与该国相关的石碑，包括芝阿鲁特恩、克邦科皮、詹布、帕西尔阿维与穆阿拉等。这些铭文是研究其政治与宗教的主要材料。
politics.en: Tarumanagara, also called the Taruma kingdom, was an early Sundanese Indianised kingdom in western Java. Its fifth-century ruler Purnawarman produced the earliest known inscriptions in Java, estimated to date from around 358 AD, and at least seven stone inscriptions connected with the kingdom have been found near Bogor and Jakarta, among them Ciaruteun, Kebon Kopi, Jambu, Pasir Awi and Muara. These inscriptions are the main evidence for its politics and religion.

economy.zh: 王国位于西爪哇的河流与火山平原之间，稻作农业与河运是经济基础，铭文提到水利工程与王家工程，说明中央能够组织灌溉与运输。
economy.en: The kingdom lay among the rivers and volcanic plains of western Java, where rice farming and river transport formed the economic base; the inscriptions mention water works and royal projects, indicating that the centre could organise irrigation and transport.

culture.zh: 铭文以帕拉瓦文字书写梵语，显示印度宗教与王权观念已传入西爪哇。普尔纳瓦曼的铭文把王权与宗教功德联系在一起，是爪哇最早的书面文化遗存。
culture.en: The inscriptions are written in Sanskrit in Pallava script, showing that Indian religious and royal ideas had reached western Java. Purnawarman's inscriptions link kingship with religious merit and are the earliest written cultural remains in Java.

events.zh: 关键节点包括约公元358年前后普尔纳瓦曼的铭文、王国在西爪哇的扩张，以及约7世纪为加卢等后继政体取代。
events.en: Key moments are Purnawarman's inscriptions around 358 AD, the kingdom's expansion in western Java and its replacement around the seventh century by successor polities such as Galuh. Its inscriptions remain the main evidence for the kingdom and its ruler.

value.zh: 普尔纳瓦曼留下爪哇已知最早的铭文，约在公元358年。
value.en: Purnawarman left the earliest known inscriptions in Java, around 358 AD.

value.zh: 在茂物与雅加达一带发现至少七块相关石碑。
value.en: At least seven related stone inscriptions were found near Bogor and Jakarta.

en: The Samudera Pasai Sultanate as a Muslim kingdom on the north coast of Sumatra from the thirteenth to the sixteenth centuries
Its foundation attributed to Merah Silu, who converted to Islam as Malik ul Salih
The limited evidence available for its history
Its position on the routes between Arabia, India and China
zh: 苏木都剌国是13至16世纪苏门答腊北岸的伊斯兰王国
相传由改宗伊斯兰教的马拉·西卢（即马利克·萨利赫）建立
可供历史研究的材料很少
地处阿拉伯、印度与中国之间的交通要道

politics.zh: 苏木都剌国又称萨穆德拉或巴赛，是13至16世纪苏门答腊北岸的伊斯兰王国，一般认为由改宗伊斯兰教并取名马利克·萨利赫的马拉·西卢建立。由于留存材料有限，其早期历史研究困难。该国地处东西方交通要道，是当时阿拉伯、印度与中国贸易的重要地点，14世纪中期曾臣服于麻喏巴歇，16世纪为亚齐苏丹国所灭。
politics.en: The Samudera Pasai Sultanate, also known as Samudera or Pasai, was a Muslim kingdom on the north coast of Sumatra from the thirteenth to the sixteenth centuries. It is believed to have been founded by Merah Silu, who converted to Islam and took the name Malik ul Salih, and little evidence survives for the study of its history. It lay on the routes between Arabia, India and China, and in the mid-fourteenth century it submitted to Majapahit before being destroyed by the Aceh Sultanate in the sixteenth century.

economy.zh: 作为马六甲海峡西端的重要港口，苏木都剌参与香料、布匹与金属贸易，中国、印度与阿拉伯商人往来其间。贸易是国家收入与国际联系的基础。
economy.en: As a major port at the western end of the Strait of Malacca, Samudera Pasai took part in the trade in spices, cloth and metals, with Chinese, Indian and Arab merchants passing through. Trade was the base of its revenue and its international links.

culture.zh: 苏木都剌是东南亚最早的伊斯兰苏丹国之一，伊斯兰教由此向周边传播。元朝与明朝的使节、旅行者马可·波罗与伊本·白图泰都曾到访或提及此地，郑和下西洋时亦三次经停。
culture.en: Samudera Pasai was among the earliest Islamic sultanates in Southeast Asia and a point from which Islam spread in the region. Yuan and Ming envoys, the travellers Marco Polo and Ibn Battuta and Zheng He's voyages all visited or mentioned the kingdom.

events.zh: 关键节点包括13世纪后期建国、1282年遣使元朝、1292年马可·波罗经停、14世纪中期臣服麻喏巴歇，以及16世纪被亚齐苏丹国所灭。
events.en: Key moments are the founding in the late thirteenth century, the embassy to the Yuan court in 1282, Marco Polo's visit in 1292, the submission to Majapahit in the mid-fourteenth century and the conquest by Aceh in the sixteenth century.

value.zh: 相传由改宗伊斯兰教的马拉·西卢建立。
value.en: It is believed to have been founded by Merah Silu, who converted to Islam.

value.zh: 马可·波罗与伊本·白图泰都曾在此停留。
value.en: Both Marco Polo and Ibn Battuta stayed there.

en: The Sultanate of Maguindanao as a Sunni Muslim sultanate ruling parts of Mindanao in the southern Philippines
Its heartland in the present Maguindanao provinces, Soccsksargen, Zamboanga Peninsula and Davao Region
Its known historical influence stretching over several centuries
Its place among the Muslim sultanates of the southern Philippines
zh: 马京达瑙苏丹国是菲律宾南部棉兰老岛的逊尼派伊斯兰苏丹国
核心地区在今马京达瑙省、索科斯克萨尔根、三宝颜半岛与达沃大区
有记载的历史影响延续数百年
是菲律宾南部伊斯兰苏丹国之一

politics.zh: 马京达瑙苏丹国是逊尼派伊斯兰苏丹国，统治菲律宾南部棉兰老岛的部分地区，核心地区包括今马京达瑙南北省、索科斯克萨尔根、三宝颜半岛与达沃大区，有记载的历史影响延续数百年。它与苏禄苏丹国等共同构成菲律宾南部的伊斯兰政权体系，与西班牙殖民势力长期对抗。
politics.en: The Sultanate of Maguindanao was a Sunni Muslim sultanate ruling parts of the island of Mindanao in the southern Philippines, its heartland in what are now the provinces of Maguindanao del Sur and del Norte, Soccsksargen, the Zamboanga Peninsula and the Davao Region, with a recorded influence stretching over several centuries. Together with the Sultanate of Sulu it formed part of the Muslim polity system of the southern Philippines and long resisted Spanish colonial power.

economy.zh: 苏丹国位于棉兰老河下游与莫罗湾一带，河运与沿海贸易连接内陆与南海商路，稻米、林产品与布匹是主要交换物。
economy.en: The sultanate lay on the lower Mindanao river and around Moro Gulf, where river transport and coastal trade linked the interior with the South China Sea routes, and rice, forest products and cloth were the main goods exchanged.

culture.zh: 社会以马京达瑙人为主体，伊斯兰教与本地达图制度结合，马京达瑙语与阿拉伯语、马来语并用于宗教与行政。苏丹与达图共同治理地方。
culture.en: Society was centred on the Maguindanaon people, with Islam combined with the local datu system and Maguindanaon, Arabic and Malay used in religion and administration. Sultans and datus governed the localities together. The sultanate's courts and mosques still mark the region.

events.zh: 关键节点包括16世纪苏丹国的形成、与西班牙殖民势力的长期战争、19世纪势力的削弱，以及20世纪初美国统治下苏丹国主权的终结。
events.en: Key moments are the formation of the sultanate in the sixteenth century, the long wars with Spanish colonial power, its weakening in the nineteenth century and the end of its sovereignty under American rule in the early twentieth century.

value.zh: 核心地区在今马京达瑙省、索科斯克萨尔根、三宝颜半岛与达沃大区。
value.en: Its heartland covered the present Maguindanao provinces, Soccsksargen, Zamboanga Peninsula and Davao Region.

value.zh: 与苏禄苏丹国等同属菲律宾南部伊斯兰政权体系。
value.en: With Sulu and others it formed the Muslim polity system of the southern Philippines.
